description: Architects Registration Board - Sri Lanka Institute of Architects
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the registration and renewal of professional architects (Chartered Architects, Architects, and Architectural Licentiates) by the Architects Registration Board. This falls under public sector professional registration and certification, which is a function of public service administration. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3), nor does it fit the specialized categories of land, legal, commercial, elections, or judicial matters. Public service professional registrations and certifications are classified under Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes).
